intent: Coordinate the smallest sufficient set of engineering workflows for a consequential multi-stage software change.

contextual: a settled design now needs coordinated implementation and proof
multiple engineering phases must cooperate without losing rollback
the change crosses components and cannot be contained by one narrow workflow
direct: deliver a consequential feature across several engineering phases
perform a risky refactor or integration with review and rollback
repair and prove a regression whose fix crosses components
paraphrased: carry an approved change through implementation, tests, review, and integration
take this cross-component repair from evidence to a verified handoff
work an important repository change through the full delivery chain

negativeIntents: already verified branch awaiting only integration
successCondition: Requested behavior is implemented, freshly verified against explicit acceptance evidence, reviewed proportional to risk, and left in an explicit integration state.
